exit 0
--- stdout
== bash
# bash completion for my-tool, generated by std/cli (decision 0165).
_my_tool() {
  local cur="${COMP_WORDS[COMP_CWORD]}" prev="${COMP_WORDS[COMP_CWORD-1]}" cmd='my-tool' i
  for ((i = 1; i < COMP_CWORD; i++)); do
    case "$cmd ${COMP_WORDS[i]}" in
      'my-tool add') cmd='my-tool add' ;;
      'my-tool remote') cmd='my-tool remote' ;;
      'my-tool remote list') cmd='my-tool remote list' ;;
      'my-tool completion') cmd='my-tool completion' ;;
    esac
  done
  case "$cmd $prev" in
    'my-tool --format') COMPREPLY=($(compgen -W 'text json' -- "$cur")); return ;;
    'my-tool --config'|'my-tool -c') return ;;
    'my-tool add --format') COMPREPLY=($(compgen -W 'text json' -- "$cur")); return ;;
    'my-tool add --config'|'my-tool add -c') return ;;
    'my-tool add --count'|'my-tool add -n') return ;;
    'my-tool remote --format') COMPREPLY=($(compgen -W 'text json' -- "$cur")); return ;;
    'my-tool remote --config'|'my-tool remote -c') return ;;
    'my-tool remote list --format') COMPREPLY=($(compgen -W 'text json' -- "$cur")); return ;;
    'my-tool remote list --config'|'my-tool remote list -c') return ;;
    'my-tool completion --format') COMPREPLY=($(compgen -W 'text json' -- "$cur")); return ;;
    'my-tool completion --config'|'my-tool completion -c') return ;;
  esac
  case "$cmd" in
    'my-tool') COMPREPLY=($(compgen -W 'add remote completion --verbose -v --format --config -c --help -h --version' -- "$cur")) ;;
    'my-tool add') COMPREPLY=($(compgen -W '--verbose -v --format --config -c --count -n --help -h --version' -- "$cur")) ;;
    'my-tool remote') COMPREPLY=($(compgen -W 'list --verbose -v --format --config -c --help -h --version' -- "$cur")) ;;
    'my-tool remote list') COMPREPLY=($(compgen -W '--verbose -v --format --config -c --help -h --version' -- "$cur")) ;;
    'my-tool completion') COMPREPLY=($(compgen -W '--verbose -v --format --config -c --help -h --version' -- "$cur")) ;;
  esac
}
complete -o default -F _my_tool my-tool
== zsh
#compdef my-tool
# zsh completion for my-tool, generated by std/cli (decision 0165).
_my_tool() {
  local cmd='my-tool' i
  for ((i = 2; i < CURRENT; i++)); do
    case "$cmd ${words[i]}" in
      'my-tool add') cmd='my-tool add' ;;
      'my-tool remote') cmd='my-tool remote' ;;
      'my-tool remote list') cmd='my-tool remote list' ;;
      'my-tool completion') cmd='my-tool completion' ;;
    esac
  done
  case "$cmd ${words[CURRENT-1]}" in
    'my-tool --format') compadd -- 'text' 'json'; return ;;
    'my-tool --config'|'my-tool -c') _files; return ;;
    'my-tool add --format') compadd -- 'text' 'json'; return ;;
    'my-tool add --config'|'my-tool add -c') _files; return ;;
    'my-tool add --count'|'my-tool add -n') _files; return ;;
    'my-tool remote --format') compadd -- 'text' 'json'; return ;;
    'my-tool remote --config'|'my-tool remote -c') _files; return ;;
    'my-tool remote list --format') compadd -- 'text' 'json'; return ;;
    'my-tool remote list --config'|'my-tool remote list -c') _files; return ;;
    'my-tool completion --format') compadd -- 'text' 'json'; return ;;
    'my-tool completion --config'|'my-tool completion -c') _files; return ;;
  esac
  local -a items
  case "$cmd" in
    'my-tool') items=('add:Adds widgets.' 'remote:Manages remotes.' 'completion:Prints a completion script.' '--verbose:print '\''more'\''' '-v:print '\''more'\''' '--format:output format' '--config:the file' '-c:the file' '--help:show this help' '-h:show this help' '--version:show the version') ;;
    'my-tool add') items=('--verbose:print '\''more'\''' '-v:print '\''more'\''' '--format:output format' '--config:the file' '-c:the file' '--count:how many' '-n:how many' '--help:show this help' '-h:show this help' '--version:show the version') ;;
    'my-tool remote') items=('list:Lists remotes.' '--verbose:print '\''more'\''' '-v:print '\''more'\''' '--format:output format' '--config:the file' '-c:the file' '--help:show this help' '-h:show this help' '--version:show the version') ;;
    'my-tool remote list') items=('--verbose:print '\''more'\''' '-v:print '\''more'\''' '--format:output format' '--config:the file' '-c:the file' '--help:show this help' '-h:show this help' '--version:show the version') ;;
    'my-tool completion') items=('--verbose:print '\''more'\''' '-v:print '\''more'\''' '--format:output format' '--config:the file' '-c:the file' '--help:show this help' '-h:show this help' '--version:show the version') ;;
  esac
  _describe 'my-tool' items
  case "$cmd" in
    'my-tool add'|'my-tool completion') _files ;;
  esac
}
if [ "$funcstack[1]" = '_my_tool' ]; then
  _my_tool "$@"
else
  compdef _my_tool my-tool
fi
== fish
# fish completion for my-tool, generated by std/cli (decision 0165).
function __my_tool_cmd
    set -l cmd 'my-tool'
    for w in (commandline -opc)[2..-1]
        switch "$cmd $w"
            case 'my-tool add'
                set cmd 'my-tool add'
            case 'my-tool remote'
                set cmd 'my-tool remote'
            case 'my-tool remote list'
                set cmd 'my-tool remote list'
            case 'my-tool completion'
                set cmd 'my-tool completion'
        end
    end
    echo $cmd
end
function __my_tool_is
    test (__my_tool_cmd) = $argv[1]
end
complete -c my-tool -f
complete -c my-tool -n "__my_tool_is 'my-tool'" -a 'add' -d 'Adds widgets.'
complete -c my-tool -n "__my_tool_is 'my-tool'" -a 'remote' -d 'Manages remotes.'
complete -c my-tool -n "__my_tool_is 'my-tool'" -a 'completion' -d 'Prints a completion script.'
complete -c my-tool -n "__my_tool_is 'my-tool'" -l verbose -s v -d 'print \'more\''
complete -c my-tool -n "__my_tool_is 'my-tool'" -l format -x -a 'text json' -d 'output format'
complete -c my-tool -n "__my_tool_is 'my-tool'" -l config -s c -r -F -d 'the file'

complete -c my-tool -n "__my_tool_is 'my-tool add'" -l verbose -s v -d 'print \'more\''
